# Purpose

These answers are representative. Award credit for correct free-body diagrams, two-stage equilibrium, consistent force and modulus units, axial wire elongations, rigid-body displacement interpolation, and physically correct tilt directions.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The supplied area and elastic modulus support equilibrium and deformation analysis. Strength factor of safety, anchor and connector stress, fatigue, wire self-weight, and rigid-member bending are intentionally excluded because the required allowable stresses and connection geometry are not supplied.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

Suggested weighting:

- context interpretation and load path: 15%;
- idealization and assumptions: 15%;
- rigid-body equilibrium: 25%;
- wire elongation and displacement compatibility: 30%;
- tilt interpretation and engineering recommendation: 15%.
